title: docs(skills): the published guides cite no issue numbers — 41 sites rewritten as self-contained rules, the rule stated in AGENTS.md (objectui#12202)
body:
Fixes #12202
Clause-②: no

Landing repo objectui · surface `skills/**` + `AGENTS.md` (governed, Tier H: this PR stays draft until an authorized approver's review is on it, and the dispatching seat lands it). Dispatched by the skills seat of PM session `session_01CinRQcE6T8SvMbhH8D3NhS`; the claim comment on the card names this branch. Maintainer ruling 2026-10-12, selected verbatim: 「A:只删 id(推荐)」 and 「不加,写成文规则(推荐)」 — ids go, dates and the 「maintainer ruling」 wording stay, no new gate, one written rule in `AGENTS.md`.

## What changed — one commit per file, in site order

Every site is rewritten as a self-contained rule (failure mode + discipline + boundary) with the issue or PR number removed. Where the number was a provenance parenthetical after a complete sentence, the parenthetical is gone and the sentence stands. Where the number was the sentence's subject, the sentence now states what the platform does, exactly as strongly as the surrounding paragraph already asserted it. Dates and every 「maintainer ruling YYYY-MM-DD」 phrase are kept; `ADR-0049` references are not issue ids and are kept. One sample pair per file (the whole diff is the commit list):

Three of the four `guides/plugin-development.md` sites are comment lines inside the `ComponentInput` typescript fence (the `os:check`-marked one). Only the comment text moved; the code the gate compiles is byte-identical, and the gate's marked population and verdict below are unchanged. The dispatch's 「no fence content changes」 clause and its 「0 non-colour hits」 target meet at exactly these three lines; I read the clause as protecting what the fences teach and compile, and record the reading here rather than leave three ids in place.

The two sites that named a reporter now name the mechanism: the renderer's node-gate diagnostic (`visibilityDiagnostic.ts` in `@object-ui/react`, the one that reports a node-gate predicate that could not be evaluated).

`evals/protocol.json`: the grid eval's `expected_output` names the behaviour (the six-key widening) instead of a card; its `must_contain` tokens (`columns`, `node`, `xl`, `className`) are untouched and still taught.

`AGENTS.md` (607 → 608, +1): one bullet in the 「两棵 skills 树都受管」 passage, after the `skills/**` bullet — the published skills cite no issue or PR number; a lesson is a self-contained rule; provenance stays in the landing PR; dates and the ruling wording stay; nothing in this repository re-derives it (said per commandment #9), and the governed-surface review is the backstop. It quotes the 2026-08-12 ruling verbatim and names the re-derivation command, not its reading.

`.changeset/12202-skills-no-issue-ids.md`: empty frontmatter — `skills/**` and `AGENTS.md` sit in no package's `files[]`, so no package releases.

Nothing else moved: no script, no gate, no `os:check` marker, no fence code.

At head `44a7d44` the same command answers exactly that one colour line and nothing else: 0 non-colour hits.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui#12204 (this lane, serialized behind this card) will edit `guides/schema-expressions.md` and `rules/protocol.md` after this lands; no fence declaration is added here, so it has nothing to rebase around except prose.
- Observation, not filed: `AGENTS.md` itself and the repository's test names cite issue numbers freely, by design (its reader is a repo agent with the tools to follow them); this rule is scoped to the published `skills/**` tree only, as ruled.
- Observation, not filed: the dispatch's gate list named `pnpm check:skill-eval-tokens`; the alias exists and runs the same script as the `node scripts/…` spelling used above.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

### 改了什么
对外发布的 `skills/objectui` 技能包里,13 个文件共 41 处写着 `objectui#NNNN` / `PR #NNNN` 之类的 issue 号,全部改写成自含的规则:多数只是删掉句末的出处括号;号作句子主语的几句改成陈述平台现在的行为(如「`dataSource` 上的 walk 已退役」);日期和「maintainer ruling YYYY-MM-DD」原样保留。`AGENTS.md` 受管段加一条规则:对外发布的 skills 不引任何 issue / PR 号,教训写成自含规则,出处留在落地它的 PR 里。另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset 声明「不发版」。不改任何脚本、门禁、`os:check` 标记或示例代码。

### 为什么改
这些技能的读者是客户的 agent,经 `npx skills add` 装进别人的仓库,没有任何工具能解一个 objectui 号 —— 数字只会引它去查(或编造)一段它追不到的历史,而且号会烂。您 2026-10-12 选了「A:只删 id」与「不加门禁,写成文规则」;原则是您 2026-08-12 的裁决「处理 issue 时犯的错应该总结成经验,保留 issue id没有意义,如果ai去查原始issue,得不偿失。」

### 风险与代价(含回滚)
风险低:只动教学文本,无代码、无发布包;技能门禁(路径、示例编译、eval 词)、changeset 门禁与读这些指南的 7 个测试文件本地全绿,技能包净减 2 行,`AGENTS.md` 加 1 行。两处判断值得您看一眼:① `plugin-development.md` 有 3 处 id 位于一个 typescript 示例的注释行里,我只改了注释文字,代码逐字节不变,示例编译门禁的计数与结论不变;② 本仓按裁决不加门禁,`AGENTS.md` 那条明说「没有门禁复核」,靠受管面评审兜底。回滚:revert 这 15 个 commit(每个文件一个)即可。

### 席位意见
(留空,席位定稿)

### 你要做的
`skills/**` 与 `AGENTS.md` 都是受管面:审阅后留一条 APPROVED review,由派发席翻 ready 并入队;本 PR 不自行入队。若您认为注释行里的 3 处 id 也属「不得改动的 fence 内容」,请在 review 里说明,我把那三行还原。
